In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''cubic-triangular tiling honeycomb''' is a [[paracompact uniform honeycomb]], constructed from [[cube]], [[triangular tiling]], and [[cuboctahedron]] cells, in a [[rhombitrihexagonal tiling]] [[vertex figure]]. It has a single-ring Coxeter diagram, {{CDD|label6|branch|3ab|branch_10l|label4}}, and is named by its two regular cells.

{{Honeycomb}}
